messages:
emma (AE): Quick heads-up — Skyline Health POC asking for a bespoke pricing package. They want 35% off list for a 12mo Dedicated commit + a 30‑day Private trial and waived setup. List ACV $180,000, they say they'd commit to ~\$120k if we match. POC starts next week. Can deal desk review? @noah
noah (RevOps): Need a short justification and margin check. Our guideline for this tier is usually max 25%. Can you paste expected usage (tokens / peak GPUs) and renewal signal? Also attach any competitor offer details.
arjun (Solutions): Technical note — POC will use high-throughput inference (batching + low-latency). Rough estimate: ~2.5B tokens/month, infra cost ~\$9k/mo at list config. We can trim model or quantize to save ~20% if needed.
emma (AE): Competitor offered 40% and promises private tenancy. Customer insists on SOC2 + data residency. Exec sponsor wants proof of performance and cost math. If we don't move, we probably lose the deal.
noah (RevOps): Please upload the deal doc. Tentative: we can consider up to 25% without Director sign-off. Anything >25% needs Rachel. Put the numbers in this calc block and share link:
```
List price: $180000
35% off -> Proposed: $117000
30% off -> Proposed: $126000
25% off -> Proposed: $135000
POC infra est: $9k/mo
```
maya (Legal): For SOC2 + data residency we need a DPA + addendum; that's standard. 30‑day Private trial OK if they sign NDA + DPA and we scope no-PI ingress. Waiving setup is doable in exchange for a signed SOW and commitment term. No special IP concessions from Legal.
arjun (Solutions): If Sales is willing to go 30% we can add limits: capped burst hours and model selection locked to reduce infra risk. Also recommend a small trial dataset obfuscation step for compliance.
noah (RevOps): Routing to Rachel for exception approval >25%. @rachel can you review the business case (logo, reference, strategic value) + margin impact? I've attached the pricing matrix and projected margin.
rachel (Dir RevOps): Quick read — need exec sponsor confirmation and expected renewal ARR. I can approve up to 30% as a one-year exception if: 1) ACV >= \$100k, 2) invoice upfront or quarterly prepay, and 3) rollback clause if usage <70% of committed by month 3. Also want a short note on go-to-customer reference value.
emma (AE): Got it — I'll get exec sponsor confirmation, upload competitor offer, and add the sponsor + ROI note. Holding final discount until Rachel signs off. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
